configs.description: The ring manager as Belden ships 9511-1903, eight rings fitted.
configs.name: base

gaps.note: the data sheet gives no count of rings, and its thumbnail, a small render, shows eight; the count is an estimate.
gaps.wanted: the number of rings in the data sheet's description or a larger picture

gaps.note: "Overall Height 3.0 in" in the Construction and Dimensions table against 5.25 in in the Variants table. 5.25 in (133.35 mm) is used, the 3U of the data sheet's own rack units; 3.0 in is the depth repeated.
gaps.wanted: the maker's drawing or product page

gaps.note: no document gives the mounting holes' count or positions, or the ears' width.
gaps.wanted: a dimensioned drawing of the panel

gaps.note: the data sheet states no cable capacity and no fill ratio, so none is recorded or estimated.
gaps.wanted: a fill table for the manager

gaps.note: the data sheet says the managers help "maintain proper bend radius" and gives no figure, so none is recorded.
gaps.wanted: the bend radius the rings maintain
no bays and no grouped ports to correlate against, so there is nothing to wire yet - group the ports first - unlocks ENTITY-MIB / Redfish correlation and monitoring overlays
a port the DCIM export types as an interface - a placement in a group whose role is a port role, with media and speed it maps - unlocks interfaces on the NetBox / Nautobot device type

attrs.note: datasheet - the material, the colour and the finish are the data sheet's table. It lists no mounting hardware for this part and no environmental space.

capacity.note: datasheet - none is stated. The data sheet's overview says only that the managers "help to maintain proper bend radius"; it gives no bend radius, no cable capacity and no fill ratio, so none is recorded and none is estimated.

chassis.note: datasheet - 3U, 19 in wide and 3.0 in (76.2 mm) deep; THE HEIGHT IS A CONFLICT, SETTLED. The Construction and Dimensions table says "Overall Height 3.0 in" and the Variants table 5.25 in. The 3.0 in is the depth repeated in the height row; the 3U of the data sheet's own rack units is 5.25 in (133.35 mm), the Variants table agrees, and the maker's BHH193UR 3U sheet states 5.25 in. So 5.25 in is taken. The width is the 482.6 of 19 in, ears included, as a rack-face part is its ears and what hangs off them. The depth is the maker's overall projection from the rail face, rings included, and not a body depth. The data sheet's Mount Type is "19 in".

color.note: estimated - "Black Powdercoat Finish" and "Color: Black". The thumbnail is a grey CAD render, so the shade is this library's render of black, lightened a little so it reads on a dark stage.

ears.note: estimated - the ears are the flat ends of the panel and are drawn with it, with no holes: no document gives their size or place.

front.note: estimated - the eight rings on their screws, end-on: each ring's front leg, 10.0 wide and 40.0 high. A vendor mark is never drawn.

guides.note: estimated - the eight rings are the guides: each a component with a `ring` guide (see its contract), cables passing along the panel through each in turn. The opening is 34.0 high by 68.7 deep.

left.note: estimated - an elevation: the plate's edge and the profiles of the two rings nearest, stacked, read off the thumbnail. The right is the same, turned round.

method.note: FIGURES FROM A DATA SHEET TABLE AND FROM A THUMBNAIL. The 9511-1903 technical data sheet (revision 0.27, 05-31-2024) states the rack units, the overall width and depth, the weight, the material and the finish, and carries one 430 px thumbnail of the part, a CAD render in grey. It states TWO HEIGHTS and NO COUNT OF RINGS. NO BELDEN DOCUMENT HOLDS A DIMENSIONED DRAWING: the manufacturer's product page returned a Cloudflare challenge (403) to the one request made for the family, and the catalog page is a script shell with no content, so the product photographs were not reached. Every figure below that is not the data sheet's table is read off the thumbnail and is `estimated`, with how. Nothing was copied from it; the figures are transcribed. The data sheet's footer ("Although Belden makes every reasonable effort ... provided on an AS IS basis") grants no licence to reuse its artwork, so only its figures are used.

mount.note: estimated - the data sheet says the part is a 19 in mount and shows no figure of how it bolts. The rings stand 3.0 in out of the plate, so it bolts to the rail face at a rack unit and stands out from it: a `rack-face` part, as the FS FHD-CMP5DR and the Chatsworth Evolution managers are. Whether the line is `rack-face` or `rack` is a choice the pull request asks the owner to accept.

rear.note: estimated - the back of the panel, plain. No Belden document shows the back of the part.

rings.note: estimated - EIGHT RINGS, A COUNT NO DATA SHEET STATES. The 9511-1903 thumbnail shows two rings stacked at each end of the panel and four more between them, one in each column, eight in all; the 9511-1904 thumbnail draws the same eight on its taller panel. The count is read off a 430 px render and may be wrong; the part's name gives none, where the 9510-1901's states "(6)". The ring is the 9510-1901's saddle ring (`belden/saddle-ring`), which the thumbnails draw in the same shape; nothing states it. The six columns are taken as evenly spaced and symmetric, 80.0 apart, the first centred 41.3 from the left end; the stacked pair is centred a quarter and three quarters of the way up the face, and a single ring is centred on it. The pull request asks the owner to accept the count.

shell.note: estimated - A SHEET BODY, NOT A BOX: the panel as a well 74.7 deep, the rings standing in it. The data sheet says "Steel" and nothing of the panel's construction.

thickness.note: estimated - 1.5, a stand-in; no Belden document states a gauge.

top.note: estimated - an elevation: the plate's edge at the rear and the top bar of the highest ring of each of the six columns from above, running out the full 74.7. The bottom is the same from underneath, where each bottom bar of the lowest ring stops at its hook.

weight.note: datasheet - 4.5 lb in the data sheet's Weight row and Variants table, 2.04 kg. The data sheet does not say whether it is a net or a shipping weight; it is stated as the weight.
